svg.title: Which step runs the engine of config.toml
svg.desc: The engine command reads the name under [engine] in config.toml and whether the engine's secret is in the environment issue-assistant. Without the secret, no engine runs, and labels and the lifecycle go on. With it, the context command writes the rules, the task and the schema of the answer, and one step of the job analyze runs the engine: Claude in the Claude Code action, with Read, Grep and Glob alone; Codex in the Codex action, in a sandbox that reads but neither writes nor reaches the network; Gemini or Copilot in the analyze command, which runs the vendor's command line with only its tools that read and without a token of GitHub. Every answer goes the same way to the job apply, which checks it before anything is written.
